Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Covers the interchangeabitity dimensions of valve core chamber No. 2 ( large bore ). 

1.1 This Indian Standard applies to core chambers of valves used on tyre/tubes for agricultural 
machines and earthmoving machines. 

2, Dlmtnslone — The dimensions of valve core chamber No. 2 shall be as given in Table 1 (P 2). 

2.1 Core Pin Head Position Tolerance — The tolerances on position of core pin head shall be as given 
In Fig. 1.

\ VALVE STEM 



Note-— The pin head shall be not more than 0*25 mm above or 090 mm below the valve mouth after inserting 
the core at a torque of: 

0*34 to 0*56 N.m for a core with an elastomeric barrel gasket; and 
0*6 to 0*8 N.m for a core with a metallic sealing barrel gasket. 

FIG. 1 CORE PIN HEAD POSITION --TOLERANCES 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This Indian Standard has been prepared on the basis of ISO 6762-1982 'Tyre valves — ISO 
core chamber No. 2' issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). 

This part of the standard covers only core chamber No. 2 (large bore). The core chamber 
No. 1 ( normal bore) is covered by IS : 11542 ( Part 1 )-ig85 'Tyre tube valve core chamber: Part 1 
Core chamber No. 1 ( normal bore )'.
